main_body: Dark grey machine casing with a large front panel carrying a purple orb, topped by two pillars and a raised back panel
top_band: Down the middle column: light grey rows ~16-20 (with a dark slot at row 19) that is the raised back panel's vertical face, then a light grey ledge at rows ~21-22 only 2px thick, then dark grey front face from row 23. No real top surface is visible.
evidence: The only horizontal band is the 2-row ledge at rows 21-22, which is a rim. The light grey area above it is the vertical face of the back panel (it has a slot) and the pillar caps are 1-2px lines. The big front panel with the orb is painted flat, with rivet dots and no inset edges. This reads as a front elevation with a thin lip, not a 3/4 object.

style.evidence: The front panel is a very large flat dark grey fill with only a few light rivet dots. Grey ramps have about 3-4 steps and the orb has about 4. The edges use a near-black/neutral dark line on the left and bottom. Beodeul references have per-material ramps, grain and many colours per tile, and this piece is much thinner and flatter than them.
